exposure: Invasive measures (uterine balloon tamponade, arterial ligation, uterine packing)
outcome: Red blood cell (RBC) transfusion within the first 24 hours of severe PPH management
cohort: Parturients with severe PPH (≥1000 mL) in a tertiary care university maternity unit in France (n=200)
finding: Clinical factors like placental abruption, estimated blood loss ≥1500 mL, and invasive measures, alongside biological factors like pre-labor hemoglobin <10 g/dL and acute-phase abnormalities (hemoglobin <7.0 g/dL, fibrinogen <2 g/L, or platelets <100 G/L) were independently associated with RBC transfusion decisions within 24 hours of severe PPH management.
